canonical_statement: Let K be a nonempty compact convex subset of a Hausdorff locally convex real topological vector space. Every pairwise commuting family of continuous affine maps from K into itself has a common fixed point in K.
domain_and_universes: E : Type u; I : Type v; real topological module E with AddCommGroup, Module Real, TopologicalSpace, T2Space, IsTopologicalAddGroup, ContinuousSMul Real, and LocallyConvexSpace Real
hypotheses: each f i maps K into K
each f i is continuous on K
each f i preserves convex two-point real combinations on K
the family commutes pairwise on K
conclusion: there exists x in K fixed by every f i
boundary_cases: The index type may be empty; emptyFamily_boundary checks that the conclusion then reduces to K.Nonempty.
